annotations.title: Reverse geocoding: place name from coordinates

description: Turn latitude and longitude into place names: the nearest populated place and the largest one within the radius (usually the town or city the point is in), with country and ISO code, administrative region, population, distance and Wikidata id, plus the other places nearby. Data from Wikidata (CC0). Use to label GPS points, photos, deliveries or IP-derived coordinates; for place name to coordinates use geocode. Example: lat=59.3293, lon=18.0686. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
